qa_pairs.question: What is the role of the Commissioner of Customs in ensuring that imported parts are utilized according to the approved Input-Output Coefficients (IOC) for manufacturing?
qa_pairs.answer: The Commissioner of the relevant VAT Commissionerate is responsible for ensuring that imported parts or materials are used for manufacturing (such as motorcycles, lifts, or computer components) in accordance with the approved Input-Output Coefficients. The Commissioner fulfills this oversight role by forming a committee or directing subordinate officers (not below the rank of Joint Commissioner or relevant VAT divisional officers) to conduct mandatory physical inspections at specified intervals (every 3 or 6 months) to verify production compliance.
